titleEn: Count Visited Nodes in a Directed Graph
title: 有向图访问计数
summary: 函数图中每个节点恰有一条出边，从每个起点沿边前进直到首次访问重复节点，返回期间访问过的不同节点数。
insight: 用入度拓扑剥离后，未删除节点恰好都在环上，可直接把各环长度写入答案。剥离节点按删除顺序逆序处理时，其后继答案已经确定，因此 answer[node]=answer[next]+1。
pitfalls: 每个弱连通分量可能有不同长度的环
题目保证节点不会指向自身，但仍可能存在二元及更长环
拓扑序必须逆序回填链上答案
返回的是不同节点数而非走过的边数

solutions.title: 拓扑剥离、环标记与逆序动态规划
solutions.idea: 先求环上答案，再沿反向拓扑序向树枝传播。
steps: 把所有入度零节点加入队列
拓扑剥离并按出队顺序记录节点
遍历仍有正入度且未赋值的节点，计算并写入所在环长度

code.java: class Solution { public int[] countVisitedNodes(List<Integer> edges){int n=edges.size();int[] indegree=new int[n],order=new int[n],answer=new int[n];for(int next:edges)indegree[next]++;Deque<Integer> queue=new ArrayDeque<>();for(int node=0;node<n;node++)if(indegree[node]==0)queue.addLast(node);int size=0;while(!queue.isEmpty()){int node=queue.removeFirst();order[size++]=node;int next=edges.get(node);if(--indegree[next]==0)queue.addLast(next);}for(int start=0;start<n;start++)if(indegree[start]>0&&answer[start]==0){int length=1;for(int node=edges.get(start);node!=start;node=edges.get(node))length++;int node=start;do{answer[node]=length;node=edges.get(node);}while(node!=start);}for(int i=size-1;i>=0;i--){int node=order[i];answer[node]=answer[edges.get(node)]+1;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun countVisitedNodes(edges:List<Int>):IntArray{val n=edges.size;val indegree=IntArray(n);val order=IntArray(n);val answer=IntArray(n);for(next in edges)indegree[next]++;val queue=java.util.ArrayDeque<Int>();for(node in 0 until n)if(indegree[node]==0)queue.addLast(node);var size=0;while(!queue.isEmpty()){val node=queue.removeFirst();order[size++]=node;val next=edges[node];if(--indegree[next]==0)queue.addLast(next)};for(start in 0 until n)if(indegree[start]>0&&answer[start]==0){var length=1;var current=edges[start];while(current!=start){length++;current=edges[current]};current=start;do{answer[current]=length;current=edges[current]}while(current!=start)};for(i in size-1 downTo 0){val node=order[i];answer[node]=answer[edges[node]]+1};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:vector<int> countVisitedNodes(vector<int>& edges){int n=edges.size();vector<int> indegree(n),order(n),answer(n);for(int next:edges)++indegree[next];queue<int> pending;for(int node=0;node<n;++node)if(indegree[node]==0)pending.push(node);int size=0;while(!pending.empty()){int node=pending.front();pending.pop();order[size++]=node;int next=edges[node];if(!--indegree[next])pending.push(next);}for(int start=0;start<n;++start)if(indegree[start]>0&&answer[start]==0){int length=1;for(int node=edges[start];node!=start;node=edges[node])++length;int node=start;do{answer[node]=length;node=edges[node];}while(node!=start);}for(int i=size-1;i>=0;--i){int node=order[i];answer[node]=answer[edges[node]]+1;}return answer;} };
